info.name: API Reference attributions Organizations > Placements API

params.name: filter[type]
params.description: Filter by placement type (placement, placementPushNotification, placementEmail, placementBatchActivation, or placementGroup)

params.name: filter[name]
params.description: Filter by exact placement name (unique within an organization per type)

params.name: filter[contentStrategyId]
params.description: Filter by the ID of the content strategy linked to the placement

params.name: include
params.description: CSV list of related resources to embed in the `included` array. Supported paths: `contentStrategy` (the direct content strategy of a non-batch placement), `slots` (the slot resources of a batch-activation or group placement), `slots.placement` (and the placement each slot references), and `slots.placement.contentStrategy` (and the content strategy of each referenced placement). Dotted paths implicitly include all intermediate resources.

params.name: page[after]
params.description: Cursor value for the next page of results

params.name: page[size]
params.description: Maximum number of records to return [1 - 200] (default = 200)
